verdict.rationale: Metronome documents API-driven subscription creation via the create-contract endpoint and a lifecycle guide covering pricing changes, trials, upgrades and downgrades. Updates are handled through the `update_subscription` action on the edit-contract endpoint, and a published OpenAPI spec backs this up. Nothing in the pack shows how to pause or cancel a subscription through the API, so half of the lifecycle the story names is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented pause endpoint/action, documented cancel/terminate endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
